---
title: "Molecule Viewer"
description: "Browser-based molecular structure viewer for PDB, XYZ, SDF, and MOL2 files."
---

```{=html}
<section class="viewer-page" aria-labelledby="viewer-title">
  <div class="viewer-intro">
    <p class="eyebrow">Kabir Lab Molecular Tools</p>
    <h1 id="viewer-title">Molecule Viewer</h1>
    <p class="lead-copy">Inspect molecular structures directly in the browser with local file loading, PDB lookup, and common molecular representations.</p>
  </div>

  <section class="molecule-viewer-shell" aria-label="Molecular structure viewer">
    <div class="molecule-viewer-toolbar" aria-label="Viewer controls">
      <label class="viewer-field">
        <span>Structure file</span>
        <input id="moleculeFileInput" type="file" accept=".pdb,.xyz,.sdf,.mol2">
      </label>

      <label class="viewer-field viewer-pdb-field">
        <span>PDB ID</span>
        <input id="moleculePdbInput" type="text" maxlength="4" placeholder="1CRN" autocomplete="off" inputmode="text">
      </label>

      <button class="viewer-button primary" id="moleculeLoadPdbButton" type="button">Load PDB</button>
      <button class="viewer-button" id="moleculeSampleButton" type="button">Sample</button>

      <label class="viewer-field">
        <span>Style</span>
        <select id="moleculeRepresentation">
          <option value="default">Default</option>
          <option value="cartoon">Cartoon</option>
          <option value="stick">Stick</option>
          <option value="sphere">Sphere</option>
          <option value="line">Line</option>
        </select>
      </label>

      <button class="viewer-button" id="moleculeResetButton" type="button">Reset</button>
      <button class="viewer-button" id="moleculeSpinButton" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Spin</button>
      <button class="viewer-button" id="moleculeDownloadButton" type="button">Image</button>
    </div>

    <div class="molecule-viewer-layout">
      <div class="molecule-viewer-stage">
        <div id="moleculeViewer" aria-label="Interactive 3D molecular viewer"></div>
      </div>

      <aside class="molecule-viewer-side" aria-label="Structure information">
        <div>
          <span class="viewer-status-label">Status</span>
          <p id="moleculeStatus">Loading sample molecule...</p>
        </div>

        <div class="viewer-meta-grid">
          <span>Format</span>
          <strong id="moleculeFormat">XYZ</strong>
          <span>Source</span>
          <strong id="moleculeSource">Sample</strong>
          <span>Atoms</span>
          <strong id="moleculeAtomCount">-</strong>
        </div>

        <p class="viewer-note">Local files remain in the browser. PDB ID loading fetches public structure files from RCSB.</p>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </section>
</section>

<script src="https://3Dmol.org/build/3Dmol-min.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  const sampleXyz = `14
Benzene sample
C      0.0000      1.4027      0.0000
H      0.0000      2.4903      0.0000
C     -1.2148      0.7014      0.0000
H     -2.1567      1.2451      0.0000
C     -1.2148     -0.7014      0.0000
H     -2.1567     -1.2451      0.0000
C      0.0000     -1.4027      0.0000
H      0.0000     -2.4903      0.0000
C      1.2148     -0.7014      0.0000
H      2.1567     -1.2451      0.0000
C      1.2148      0.7014      0.0000
H      2.1567      1.2451      0.0000`;

  const viewerElement = document.getElementById("moleculeViewer");
  const statusElement = document.getElementById("moleculeStatus");
  const formatElement = document.getElementById("moleculeFormat");
  const sourceElement = document.getElementById("moleculeSource");
  const atomCountElement = document.getElementById("moleculeAtomCount");
  const representationElement = document.getElementById("moleculeRepresentation");
  const spinButton = document.getElementById("moleculeSpinButton");

  if (!viewerElement || typeof window.$3Dmol === "undefined") {
    showStatus("The molecular viewer could not load. Refresh the page and try again.", true);
    return;
  }

  const viewer = window.$3Dmol.createViewer(viewerElement, {
    backgroundColor: "#fbfaf7",
    antialias: true
  });

  let currentFormat = "xyz";
  let currentSource = "Sample";
  let isSpinning = false;

  function showStatus(message, isError) {
    if (!statusElement) {
      return;
    }
    statusElement.textContent = message;
    statusElement.classList.toggle("is-error", Boolean(isError));
  }

  function setMeta(format, source, atomCount) {
    formatElement.textContent = format.toUpperCase();
    sourceElement.textContent = source;
    atomCountElement.textContent = atomCount ? String(atomCount) : "-";
  }

  function detectFormat(filename) {
    const extension = filename.split(".").pop().toLowerCase();
    const formats = {
      pdb: "pdb",
      xyz: "xyz",
      sdf: "sdf",
      mol2: "mol2"
    };

    if (!formats[extension]) {
      throw new Error("Use a PDB, XYZ, SDF, or MOL2 file.");
    }

    return formats[extension];
  }

  function estimateAtomCount(data, format) {
    const lines = data.split(/\r?\n/);

    if (format === "xyz") {
      const count = Number.parseInt(lines[0], 10);
      return Number.isFinite(count) ? count : null;
    }

    if (format === "pdb") {
      return lines.filter(line => line.startsWith("ATOM") || line.startsWith("HETATM")).length;
    }

    if (format === "sdf" || format === "mol2") {
      return lines.filter(line => /^\s*[A-Z][a-z]?\s+[-0-9.]+\s+[-0-9.]+\s+[-0-9.]+/.test(line)).length || null;
    }

    return null;
  }

  function clearSurface() {
    if (typeof viewer.removeAllSurfaces === "function") {
      viewer.removeAllSurfaces();
    }
  }

  function applyStyle() {
    const styleName = representationElement.value;
    viewer.setStyle({}, {});
    clearSurface();

    if ((styleName === "default" || styleName === "cartoon") && currentFormat === "pdb") {
      viewer.setStyle({ polymer: true }, {
        cartoon: { color: "spectrum" }
      });
      viewer.setStyle({ hetflag: true, water: false }, {
        stick: { radius: 0.22, colorscheme: "Jmol" }
      });
      viewer.setStyle({ water: true }, {
        sphere: { scale: 0.18, color: "#7fb7d8" }
      });
    } else if (styleName === "stick" || styleName === "default") {
      viewer.setStyle({}, {
        stick: { radius: 0.2, colorscheme: "Jmol" }
      });
    } else if (styleName === "sphere") {
      viewer.setStyle({}, {
        sphere: { scale: 0.33, colorscheme: "Jmol" }
      });
    } else if (styleName === "line") {
      viewer.setStyle({}, {
        line: { colorscheme: "Jmol" }
      });
    } else if (styleName === "cartoon") {
      viewer.setStyle({}, {
        stick: { radius: 0.2, colorscheme: "Jmol" }
      });
    }

    viewer.zoomTo();
    viewer.render();
  }

  function loadStructure(data, format, source) {
    viewer.clear();
    currentFormat = format;
    currentSource = source;
    viewer.addModel(data, format);
    setMeta(format, source, estimateAtomCount(data, format));
    applyStyle();
    showStatus("Loaded " + source + ".");
  }

  document.getElementById("moleculeFileInput").addEventListener("change", async event => {
    const file = event.target.files[0];
    if (!file) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const format = detectFormat(file.name);
      const data = await file.text();
      loadStructure(data, format, file.name);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      showStatus(error.message, true);
    }
  });

  document.getElementById("moleculeLoadPdbButton").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const pdbId = document.getElementById("moleculePdbInput").value.trim().toUpperCase();

    if (!/^[A-Z0-9]{4}$/.test(pdbId)) {
      showStatus("Enter a valid four-character PDB ID.", true);
      return;
    }

    try {
      showStatus("Loading PDB " + pdbId + "...");
      const response = await fetch("https://files.rcsb.org/download/" + pdbId + ".pdb");
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("PDB " + pdbId + " could not be loaded.");
      }
      const pdbText = await response.text();
      loadStructure(pdbText, "pdb", "PDB " + pdbId);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      showStatus(error.message, true);
    }
  });

  document.getElementById("moleculeSampleButton").addEventListener("click", () => {
    loadStructure(sampleXyz, "xyz", "Sample");
  });

  representationElement.addEventListener("change", applyStyle);

  document.getElementById("moleculeResetButton").addEventListener("click", () => {
    viewer.zoomTo();
    viewer.render();
  });

  spinButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    isSpinning = !isSpinning;
    viewer.spin(isSpinning);
    spinButton.textContent = isSpinning ? "Stop" : "Spin";
    spinButton.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(isSpinning));
  });

  document.getElementById("moleculeDownloadButton").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (typeof viewer.pngURI !== "function") {
      showStatus("Image export is unavailable in this browser.", true);
      return;
    }

    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = viewer.pngURI();
    link.download = "kabir-lab-molecule.png";
    link.click();
  });

  window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
    viewer.resize();
  });

  loadStructure(sampleXyz, "xyz", "Sample");
})();
</script>
```
